energy.home.intro: Solar, wind, storage and the utility line, normalized into one site reading. The dashboard follows the telemetry store over Server-Sent Events; no page reload is needed when a source speaks or a threshold trips.
energy.home.sources: The PV strings, microinverters and turbine lines that feed the site.
energy.home.storage: State of charge, cell extremes and the L51 CAN profile of the LiFePO4 bank.
energy.home.grid: Import, export, voltage and frequency, with strict zero-export when the utility restricts back-feed.
energy.home.modes: Off-grid islanding, utility synchronization, peak shaving and tariff windows.
energy.live.generation_hint: PV and wind, summed at the bus
energy.sources.title: Generation sources
energy.sources.intro: Each line reports power, voltage, current and temperature. A reading is normalized to the unit the store names, and a line that reports only two of the three electrical figures has the third derived.
energy.storage.title: Battery storage
energy.storage.intro: The LiFePO4 bank: state of charge, state of health, cell extremes, temperature and the protocol profile the BMS speaks.
energy.grid.title: Grid interface
energy.grid.intro: The utility line reports import and export separately, so a direction is never a sign to decode. Zero export is a policy, not a subtraction.
energy.loads.title: Loads
energy.loads.intro: Priority 1 is life safety and is never shed. Priority 2 is essential. Priority 3 is discretionary and is the first the controller disconnects.
energy.modes.title: Operating modes
energy.modes.intro: Off-grid forms the local reference and protects the battery; on-grid synchronizes and enforces zero export; hybrid balances generation, storage and the tariff.
energy.safety.title: Safety and thresholds
energy.safety.intro: Every threshold is an integer in the unit the column names. A form is checked against the forms module's number rule before it reaches the policy, and every change is written to the audit trail.
energy.faults.title: Power faults
energy.faults.intro: Critical power faults are written to the telemetry SQLite/WAL store and pushed to every open dashboard over SSE. Project:
energy.events.title: Events
energy.events.intro: Every mode change, operator override, generator start, threshold change and fault transition.
energy.settings.title: Settings
energy.settings.intro: The application's own settings, the driver seam and where the store lives.
energy.settings.env: ROBOHUB_DRIVER_MODE selects the seam: mock runs the simulator, hardware accepts readings at /api/energy/ingest.
